entities.summary: Franz Josef Hinkelammert was a German-born Costa Rican theologian and economist, an influential theorist of liberation theology who wrote theological critiques of capitalism. He was one of the co-founders of the influential Departamento Ecuménico de Investigaciones in Sabanilla, Costa Rica, along with Hugo Assmann and Pablo Richard.
